headline: Maximize Your CTV & Video Monetization

features.title: Ultra-Low Latency Routing
features.body: S2S endpoints process bid transactions in under 15 milliseconds, minimizing buffering and preventing ad timeout drops.

features.title: Yield & Floor Optimization
features.body: Protect inventory value using granular floor pricing rules by country, device environment, and placement type.

features.title: SSAI & Ad Podding Ready
features.body: Fully compatible with Server-Side Ad Insertion (SSAI) protocols and dynamic VMAP ad podding for smooth, broadcast-quality ad breaks.

features.title: Transparent Payments
features.body: Predictable settlement terms backed by standardized IAB impression verification and continuous reporting access.
